description: Synthetic Two-Plant Hydropower Balance Benchmark is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Arnaldo Mendes Pires Junior (Radix Engenharia e Software). Synthetic Two-Plant Hydropower Balance Benchmark v1.0.0 is a reproducible academic benchmark for hourly water-balance modelling in a synthetic two-plant hydropower cascade. The dataset contains seven frozen inflow scenarios, deterministic balance reference results for 252 constant-power cases, derived GIVP optimisation references, figures, manifests, checksums and interoperability specifications. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
